page.layout: One printed page with a single text column, two small marginal notes in the left margin beside it, and the running head above. Right of the text column is a sliver of the neighbouring page (edge only, with running head "LIB." and cut-off lines), which is left out.

main_text.p: solitariam vitam agentes, ad Imperato-ris seueritatem extenuandam in hunc modum rescribit [Ad soli-tariam vi-tam agen-tes.Siquidem Pater, nempe Constantinus Eusebianorum ca-lumnia Athanasium in Gallias ad tempus amandauit, quo liberior essetab eorum crudelitate,qui illi per insidias im-minebant] : cum tamen ipse alibi in ea sententia pronuncianda, Apolog.2.emicuisse Cæsaris iram, & atroces minas effudisse testatur. Quid hic hæres Marce Pontifex Romane? Imperatorem Arrianis iam aures accommodasse vides, mag. num Athanasium in exilium misisse; imò quod peius, post baptismum Arus-pices consuluisse, Faustam Augustam, Crispum filium, Licinium Nepotem inter-ficiendos mandasse; non hæc recenseo, vt Zozimus in huius optimi Imperatoris contumeliam: sed vt ostendam, pos-se optimos Reges aliquando optimis se opponere, nec statim tamen humana potestate esse coercendos, multò minùs trucidandos, aut à suo deturbandos imperio.

page.notes: Left margin notes: "c" note reads "Adsoli-tariam vi-tam agen-tes" (long s in "Ad soli-" read as s); "d" note "Apolog.2." Right-hand neighbouring page only partly visible; not transcribed. Reading of "seueritatem" from a faint long-s form; "mag." sits in the text line and was kept as printed. "Arus-pices" is read from a hyphenated line break; the printed form is clear enough but the hyphen position is worth checking.
